# Zscaler CASB Activity Overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSCASBActivityLogs.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

content.query:
_Im_AuditEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSCasbactivitylog'
| extend EventType=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('EventOriginalType','')), Operation, tostring(AdditionalFields['Application']))
| summarize EventCount=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,1h), EventType
content.title: CASB Event Trend Analysis by Type Over Time

content.query:
_Im_AuditEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSCasbactivitylog'
| summarize EventCount=count() by SourceIP=SrcIpAddr
| order by EventCount desc
content.title: CASB Distribution of Events by Source IP

content.query:
_Im_AuditEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSCasbactivitylog'
| project EventTimestamp=TimeGenerated, User=ActorUsername, Action=Operation, SourceIP=SrcIpAddr
| sort by EventTimestamp desc
content.title: CASB Detailed Log Entries for Security Events
